title: "Calendar and settings"

---

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-content.mjs from Limitations.md. Edit the source in the Kanade repository, then run npm run sync. -->

Gaps in the Calendar Surface, the Settings window and its niri page.

- The Outputs section of the niri page does not cover custom modes and modelines, mirroring, `max-bpc` (niri 26.04 does not parse it), layout of monitors on a canvas, or the blocks of monitors that are not connected; edit those in the file. A live change lasts only until niri reloads its config and is written only by Keep; Kanade stopped by SIGTERM or SIGINT during one puts the monitor back first (3 s at most); killed by SIGKILL, or crashed, it puts it back at its next start (the file is ignored if older than 5 minutes), not before. A monitor on a custom mode cannot have its mode tried. Putting a monitor back never turns off the last one that is on. The page does not know a change failed the monitor itself (a mode it lists that the display then shows black): Revert, Esc or the 15 seconds put it back. See [ADR 0119](https://github.com/0x1d1e/kanade/blob/main/docs/adr/0119-kanade-edits-nieris-config-on-request.md).
- The Settings window is a normal window, so niri tiles it. To float it, add a niri window rule: `window-rule { match app-id="kanade" title="Kanade Settings"; open-floating true; }`.
- The lock screen's layout label shows only with two or more keyboard layouts, and follows what niri says; it can be stale for a moment after niri restarts. It shows no other state: no notification, media or battery.
- Settings' Health page shows what the checks found when it opened or Check again was pressed; it fixes nothing, so each warning says what to run. The first-start notice counts the checks 30 s after Kanade starts, so a service that starts later may be counted missing, and it is told only once, whatever the count.
- The Calendar Surface changes and removes only the events it added (files in `$XDG_DATA_HOME/kanade/events`); every other event is read-only there, and nothing is written to Google, a vdir or a subscription. A change keeps what the file holds (a place, a reminder) but there is no way to type a repeat, a place, a reminder or a time zone, and a file with a repeat, several events or a zoned time, or an event that spans several days, ends on a later day, is timed with no end, has seconds in its time or is all-day with a title that starts like a time, is refused for change rather than cut to fit (it can still be removed, unless the file holds another UID's event too). A change or removal of an event whose file changed since it showed is refused (`Changed elsewhere`). A removal has no undo. See [ADR 0113](https://github.com/0x1d1e/kanade/blob/main/docs/adr/0113-owned-events-are-edited-in-place-and-keep-what-they-hold.md).
